title: OOP coursework supported by instructor-moderated AI forum responses
summary: Students complete Java object-oriented programming coursework and post questions to an asynchronous discussion forum. AIDA drafts course-grounded responses, but the instructor reviews, edits, and approves them before students see them.

sources.title: Oversight in Action: Experiences with Instructor-Moderated LLM Responses in an Online Discussion Forum
sources.evidence_quote: AIDA to respond to 95 of them

assessment.summary: Complete course programming work while seeking help through the Ed Discussion forum.
student_actions: Post questions to the course forum.
Use instructor-approved responses to continue the work.

student_role.description: Students received selected GPT-4 drafts only after instructor moderation; some posts appeared anonymously.

provenance.extraction_method: Full PDF read from pdftotext output.

reported_results: AIDA was deployed for six weeks in a 307-student course and used for 95 of 253 retained forum posts.

evidence_excerpts.quote: AIDA to respond to 95 of them
